answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Work waits on the nebula until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the signal of the next round. By the basalt of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
